decisive_items: Multi-lobulated cyst measuring 3.3 cm × 3.0 cm × 3.9 cm at popliteal fossa
3 x 3 cm sized palpable lump at posterior aspect of right knee joint
No unusual findings in ligament, cartilage, and meniscus
response.rationale: Popliteal fossa location, multi-lobulated cyst, and absence of intra-articular pathology strongly favor Baker's cyst over ganglion or meniscal cyst.

rejected.why: No meniscal abnormality on MRI; meniscal cyst would require associated meniscal tear or degeneration.
